one_line_input.description: The raw one-line request the brief was generated from.

big_idea.description: One sentence: the thought the asset expresses. Intent, not mechanism.

visual_description.description: What should be seen in frame. Concrete, not vibes.

style_notes.description: Tone, mood, reference aesthetic. No tool/model names.

ad_copy.description: The actual text that must render ON the asset. A static ad without copy is not a static ad — this is not optional for ad formats. Set has_copy false only for pure product/mood photography with no on-image text (e.g. a reference plate).

has_copy.description: False only when the format genuinely carries no on-image text.

headline.description: The dominant line of copy. Short — this is a glance-and-go medium, not a paragraph. Empty string only if has_copy is false.

subhead.description: Optional supporting line. Empty string if unused.

cta.description: Optional call to action (e.g. 'Shop now', 'Learn more'). Empty string if unused.

placement.description: Where the copy sits in frame and why (e.g. 'lower third, left-aligned, clear of the product'). Required whenever has_copy is true.

must_preserve.description: Load-bearing elements. Changing these breaks the idea. When has_copy is true, must include at least one entry about the headline staying legible/spelled correctly/unobstructed.

forbidden.description: Elements that would actively damage the idea. May be empty.
